elements.name: Breath of Winter
elements.desc: Spend 6 ki points to cast cone of cold.

elements.id: Elemental Discipline:Clench of the North Wind
elements.name: Clench of the North Wind
elements.desc: Spend 3 ki points to cast hold person.

elements.name: Eternal Mountain Defense
elements.desc: Spend 5 ki points to cast stoneskin on yourself.

elements.id: Elemental Discipline:Fangs of the Fire Snake
elements.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
elements.desc: Spend 1 ki point to extend your unarmed reach by 10 feet and deal fire damage; spend 1 more on a hit for an extra 1d10 fire damage.

elements.name: Fist of Four Thunders
elements.desc: Spend 2 ki points to cast thunderwave.

elements.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
elements.desc: Spend 2 or more ki points to blast a creature for 3d10 bludgeoning damage and push it away (Strength save).

elements.name: Flames of the Phoenix
elements.desc: Spend 4 ki points to cast fireball.

elements.name: Gong of the Summit
elements.desc: Spend 3 ki points to cast shatter.

elements.name: Mist Stance
elements.desc: Spend 4 ki points to cast gaseous form on yourself.

elements.name: Ride the Wind
elements.desc: Spend 4 ki points to cast fly on yourself.

elements.name: River of Hungry Flame
elements.desc: Spend 5 ki points to cast wall of fire.

elements.id: Elemental Discipline:Rush of the Gale Spirits
elements.name: Rush of the Gale Spirits
elements.desc: Spend 2 ki points to cast gust of wind.

elements.name: Shape the Flowing River
elements.desc: Spend 1 ki point to reshape ice or water in a 30-foot area.

elements.name: Sweeping Cinder Strike
elements.desc: Spend 2 ki points to cast burning hands.

elements.name: Water Whip
elements.desc: Spend 2 or more ki points to lash a creature for 3d10 bludgeoning damage and pull or knock it prone (Dexterity save).

elements.name: Wave of Rolling Earth
elements.desc: Spend 6 ki points to cast wall of stone.
